description: Source code for a Kubernetes API server admission webhook plugin, defining the Webhook struct, its initialization, configuration, and logic for invoking webhooks based on admission attributes.

classes.name: Webhook
classes.description: Represents an admission webhook with infrastructure to define admission logic, including configuration, matching, and dispatching webhooks.

methods.name: NewWebhook
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Webhook instance with provided configuration and factories.

methods.name: SetAuthenticationInfoResolverWrapper
methods.description: Sets the authentication info resolver wrapper for the webhook client manager.

methods.name: SetServiceResolver
methods.description: Sets the service resolver for the webhook client manager.

methods.name: SetExternalKubeClientSet
methods.description: Sets the external Kubernetes client set for the webhook, used for namespace matching.

methods.name: SetExternalKubeInformerFactory
methods.description: Sets external informer factory, initializes namespace lister and webhook source, and sets readiness check.

methods.name: SetAuthorizer
methods.description: Assigns an authorizer to the webhook for access control.

methods.name: ValidateInitialization
methods.description: Validates that the webhook is properly initialized with necessary components.

methods.name: ShouldCallHook
methods.description: Determines if the webhook should be invoked for given admission attributes based on rules and matching conditions.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches the admission request to the configured webhooks if the webhook is ready and not exempted.
